49188-daisy-herself.description: A book by Will E. Ingersoll. on since her earliest girlhood, had developed an innate awareness of "fellows"--knew it. None of her several reasons for this escapade had been the usual one--love. It suited her, however, to let Beatty think that she had come prepared to follow him to the world's end--a lengthy journey, upon which the railway ticket Beatty had bought for her was only good for the first two hundred miles.

arxiv-2012-03915.title: 1D Anisotropic Surface Wave Tomography with Bayesian Inference
arxiv-2012-03915.creator: John Keith. Magali
arxiv-2012-03915.description: Abstract Classically, anisotropic surface wave tomography is treated as an optimisation problem where it proceeds through a linearised two-step approach. It involves the construction of 2D group or phase velocity maps for each considered period, followed by the inversion of local dispersion curves inferred from these maps for 1D depth-functions of the elastic parameters.

arxiv-2105-00397.title: OR-Net: Pointwise Relational Inference for Data Completion under Partial Observation DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 Conference: ; ; 1975 CCS: Theory of computation Semi-supervised learning CCS: Theory of computation Models of learning CCS: Theory of computation Structured prediction
arxiv-2105-00397.creator: Qianyu Feng, Linchao Zhu, Bang Zhang, Pan Pan, Yi Yang
arxiv-2105-00397.description: Abstract . Contemporary data-driven methods are typically fed with full supervision on large-scale datasets which limits their applicability. However, in the actual systems with limitations such as measurement error and data acquisition problems, people usually obtain incomplete data. Although data completion has attracted wide attention, the underlying data pattern and relativity are still under-developed.

arxiv-2203-10490.title: The Shadow Formalism of Galilean CFT 2
arxiv-2203-10490.creator: Bin Chen, Reiko Liu
arxiv-2203-10490.description: Abstract In this work, we develop the shadow formalism for two-dimensional Galilean conformal field theory (GCFT 2 ). We define the principal series representation of Galilean conformal symmetry group and find its relation with the Wigner classification, then we determine the shadow transform of local operators.

arxiv-2305-03934.title: Revisiting Lightweight Compiler Provenance Recovery on ARM Binaries
arxiv-2305-03934.creator: Jason Kim, Daniel Genkin, Kevin Leach
arxiv-2305-03934.description: Abstract A binary’s behavior is greatly influenced by how the compiler builds its source code. Although most compiler configuration details are abstracted away during compilation, recovering them is useful for reverse engineering and program comprehension tasks on unknown binaries, such as code similarity detection. We observe that previous work has thoroughly explored this on x86-64 binaries.

arxiv-2310-08177.title: Improving Fast Minimum-Norm Attacks with Hyperparameter Optimization
arxiv-2310-08177.creator: Giuseppe Floris 1∗, Raffaele Mura 1∗, Luca Scionis 1∗, Giorgio Piras 1,2, Maura Pintor 1, Ambra Demontis 1 and Battista Biggio 1 1- University of Cagliari - Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering 2- Sapienza University of Rome - Department of Computer Engineering
arxiv-2310-08177.description: Abstract Evaluating the adversarial robustness of machine-learning models using gradient-based attacks is challenging. In this work, we show that hyperparameter optimization can improve fast minimum-norm attacks by automating the selection of the loss function, the optimizer, and the step-size scheduler, along with the corresponding hyperparameters.

arxiv-2505-11254.title: 𝚫 \mathbf{\Delta} Attention: Fast and Accurate Sparse Attention Inference by Delta Correction
arxiv-2505-11254.creator: Jeffrey Willette, Heejun Lee, Sung Ju Hwang, KAIST, DeepAuto.ai
arxiv-2505-11254.description: Abstract The attention mechanism of a transformer has a quadratic complexity, leading to high inference costs and latency for long sequences. However, attention matrices are mostly sparse, which implies that many entries may be omitted from computation for efficient inference. Sparse attention inference methods aim to reduce this computational burden; however, they also come with a troublesome performance degradation.

arxiv-2506-14276.title: Don’t throw the baby out with the bathwater: How and why deep learning for ARC
arxiv-2506-14276.creator: Jack Cole, Mohamed Osman, MindsAITufa Labs {jack, mohamed}@tufalabs.ai
arxiv-2506-14276.description: Abstract The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC-AGI) presents a formidable challenge for AI systems. Despite the typically low performance on ARC, the deep learning paradigm remains the most effective known strategy for generating skillful (state-of-the-art) neural networks (NN) across varied modalities and tasks in vision, language etc.

arxiv-2507-15559.title: \sysName : Guiding the Creation of Multi-agent Workflows with Design Space Visualization as a Thinking Scaffold
arxiv-2507-15559.creator: \authororcid Pan Hao0009-0006-4473-5764, \authororcid Dongyeop Kang0000-0002-9021-1789, Nicholas Hinds, and \authororcid Qianwen Wang0000-0002-1825-0097
arxiv-2507-15559.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by \authororcid Pan Hao0009-0006-4473-5764, \authororcid Dongyeop Kang0000-0002-9021-1789, Nicholas Hinds, and \authororcid Qianwen Wang0000-0002-1825-0097. Multi-agent workflows have become an effective strategy for tackling complicated tasks by decomposing them into multiple sub-tasks and assigning them to specialized agents. However, designing optimal workflows remains challenging due to the vast and intricate design space. Current practices rely heavily on the intuition and expertise of practitioners, often resulting in design fixation or an unstructured, time-consuming exploration of trial-and-error.

arxiv-2602-12174.title: Probing baryonic feedback with fast radio bursts: joint analyses with cosmic shear and galaxy clustering 2026 Probing baryonic feedback with fast radio bursts: joint analyses with cosmic shear and galaxy clustering – A
arxiv-2602-12174.creator: Amy Wayland, David Alonso, Robert Reischke
arxiv-2602-12174.description: Abstract Cosmological inference from weak lensing (WL) surveys is increasingly limited by uncertainties in baryonic physics, which suppress the non-linear matter power spectrum on small scales. Multi-probe analyses that incorporate complementary tracers of the gas distribution around haloes offer a pathway to calibrate these effects and recover unbiased cosmological information.

pmc-10636066.title: Impact of different levels of probiotic on productive performance, nutrient retention of broiler chickens fed low protein diets
pmc-10636066.creator: Zeyad Kamal Imari, Hayder Raheem Alnajm, Sarah Jasim Zamil
pmc-10636066.description: Objective:This research assesses whether probiotics could enhance growth performance and improve nutrient digestibility in birds fed with low-protein diets.Materials and Methods:A total of 250 1-day-old ROSS chicks were used in a completely randomized design consisting of 5 treatments with 5 replicates and 10 birds for each replicate.

pmc-11356747.title: Is Raman Spectroscopy of Fingernails a Promising Tool for Diagnosing Systemic and Dermatological Diseases in Adult and Pediatric Populations?
pmc-11356747.creator: Teresa Tabasz, Natalia Szymańska, Katarzyna Bąk-Drabik, Aleksandra Damasiewicz-Bodzek, Agnieszka Nowak, Adam Reich
pmc-11356747.description: Background: Raman spectroscopy is a well-known tool used in criminology, molecular biology, and histology. It is also applied to diagnose bone mineral disorders by taking advantage of the similarity of the structure of keratin and bone collagen. Raman spectroscopy can also be used in dermatology and diabetology.

pmc-11532541.title: Rapid synthesis of cobalt manganese phosphate by microwave-assisted hydrothermal method and application as positrode material in supercapatteries
pmc-11532541.creator: Jayesh Cherusseri, Susmi Anna Thomas, A. K. Pandey, MA Zaed, N. K. Farhana, R. Saidur
pmc-11532541.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Electrochemical energy storage devices with high specific capacity are of utmost important for the next-generation electronic devices. Supercapatteries (SCs) are highly demanded energy storage devices nowadays as these bridge the low energy supercapacitors and low power batteries. Herein, we report a rapid synthesis of cobalt manganese phosphate (COMAP) by microwave-assisted hydrothermal method and facile fabrication of SCs using electrodes comprising of COMAP as positrode material.

pmc-11644404.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The need to improve both the cost of food production and lower the environmental impact of food production is key to being able to sustainably feed the projected growth of the human population.

pmc-12403299.title: Enhancing privacy protection of physical examination data through synthetic algorithms based on differential privacy
pmc-12403299.creator: Weili Zhang, Ran Liu, Xinyi Zhu, Xiaojin Yu, Depeng Jiang
pmc-12403299.description: BackgroundHealth physical examinations play a crucial role in early detection of cancer and chronic disease. However, privacy concerns limit the utilization of this kind of data for health interventions and research. Synthetic data methods based on differential privacy are increasingly used to create complete datasets that protect privacy while enabling data analysis and result interpretation.

pmc-12433120.title: Clinical phenotype and molecular genetic analysis of 24 cases of Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome
pmc-12433120.creator: Ziying Wu, Xi Yin, Xiuzhen Li, Huifen Mei, Junzan Li, Zien Huang, Jing Cheng, Peng Yi, Wen Zhang, Aijing Xu
pmc-12433120.description: BackgroundBeckwith-Wiedemann syndrome (BWS) is a genetic disorder characterized by various clinical features. The purpose of this study was to investigate the molecular diagnostic and clinical features of BWS in Chinese pediatric patients.MethodsThis retrospective study reviewed the clinical data of 24 pediatric patients diagnosed with BWS at the Guangzhou Women and Children’s Medical Center, Guangzhou Medical University from 2014 to 2024.

pmc-12510744.creator: Jae Myoung Noh
pmc-12510744.description: g periorbital edema, lid retraction, proptosis, and diplopia. Owing to the anti-inflammatory effects and radiosensitivity of lymphocytes infiltrating the orbit, orbital radiotherapy (RT) in combination with glucocorticoids is considered an effective second-line treatment for active moderate-to-severe TED, particularly in the presence of progressive diplopia [4,5].

pmc-12965010.title: Helically Magnetized Plasma: From Photonic Fermi‐Arc Metal to Chirality‐Free Uniaxial Medium
pmc-12965010.creator: Wanxia Huang, Jinyu Hou, Maosheng Wang, Lei Zhou, Shaojie Ma
pmc-12965010.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fermi‐arc metals, unconventional semi‐metals featuring cylindrical Fermi surfaces formed by Fermi arcs, have recently attracted extensive attention for realizing a novel metallic phase that retains chiral anomaly responses yet suppresses quantum oscillations. Although it was proposed that spatially twisting a superlattice of thin Weyl metals can form a Fermi‐arc metal, previous local‐approximation analyses are valid only for slowly varying systems and cannot capture all rich physics in such systems.

pmc-13144744.title: Determinants of HPV vaccine hesitancy in South Asia: a systematic review
pmc-13144744.creator: Zoha Imtiaz Malik, Abdul Momin Rizwan Ahmad, Sehar Iqbal
pmc-13144744.description: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine hesitancy is a pronounced issue in low- and middle-income countries, including South Asia. The current systematic review focuses on examining vaccine hesitancy determinants, among South Asian countries. A comprehensive literature search was conducted across 2 data bases; PubMed and Scopus, using appropriate search strings, from the years 2018–2025.

pmc-13214407.title: Multidimensional body image and self-esteem: a latent profile analysis differentiating orthorexia nervosa and exercise addiction from disordered eating
pmc-13214407.creator: Hanna Wachten, Jana Strahler
pmc-13214407.description: BackgroundOrthorexia Nervosa (ON), the obsessive preoccupation with healthy eating, and Exercise Addiction (EA), the behavioral addiction to exercise, are controversially discussed as potential mental disorders. The unclear distinction between these conditions and disordered eating, especially regarding restrictive eating and instrumental exercise behaviors, contributes to this debate.

pmc-13491257.title: The complex interaction between mammalian herbivores, climate, soil and fire has shaped the evolution and distribution of plant spinescence across biogeographical realms
pmc-13491257.creator: Rachel Souza Ferreira, Jens J Ringelberg, Colin Hughes, Eduardo Arlé, Friederike J R Wölke, Kyle W Tomlinson, Renske E Onstein
pmc-13491257.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Summary The evolutionary arms race between plants and herbivores led to numerous plant adaptations, including spinescence. However, the balance between herbivory and abiotic conditions in the evolution of spinescence remains unclear.We integrated phylogenetic, geographic, and trait data for 2686 species of an ecologically diverse and spinescent pantropical lineage, mimosoid legumes, with distribution data on 368 extant and extinct mammalian herbivores ≥ 10 kg.

pmc-13637299.title: Risk factors for intra-abdominal abscess formation after appendectomy: a multicenter retrospective cohort study from Africa
pmc-13637299.creator: Ali Mohamed Arif, Muhammet Ali Aydemir, Tugrul Ozdemir, Abdiwahab Dahir Alasow, Feride İrem Simsek, Orhan Alimoglu
pmc-13637299.description: BackgroundPostoperative intra-abdominal abscess (IAA) remains a significant cause of morbidity after appendectomy, particularly in low-resource settings where delayed presentation and advanced disease are common. This study aimed to identify factors associated with postoperative IAA formation after appendectomy in an African setting and to evaluate management strategies and outcomes.
